unavailable.quarterback: No player-level returning QB production, starter histories, or dated availability in the frozen archive. Aggregate offensive returning usage is already in the baseline and is not a QB test.
unavailable.turnoverSpecialTeams: No interceptions, fumble/recovery counts, return-TD attribution, or special-teams EPA in the frozen archive. Score/drive discrepancies cannot identify these causes.
unavailable.richerEfficiency: Success rate and competitive points per drive tested. Explosiveness and finishing-drive/red-zone opportunities are not retained; points per drive is not a finishing-drive test.

limitation: Exploratory reused development folds with historical source reconstruction. Six families were screened through explicit proxies, not exhaustive implementations. No injuries, starter changes, recovery luck, complete special-teams EPA, or finishing-drive opportunities were tested. No external ratings are model inputs. Learned contributions and probabilities exclude their forecast season. A no-factor recalibration control separates additional calibration flexibility from feature evidence. No production model was changed.
